name: Town of Beaufort
title: Town of Beaufort: Gallant’s Channel Living Shoreline
note: Excellent water-level coverage (Beaufort 8656483, 50+ yr, <1 km). No in-situ waves in Gallants Channel – SWAN needs local wind from CLKN7/BFTN7; offshore 41159/41025 only as boundary.

name: Down East Carteret County
title: Down East Carteret County: Cedar Island NC 12 Protection
setting: Soundside – Core Sound / Cedar Island Bay
note: Beaufort tide gauge ~14 km west, across Core/Back Sound – tidal phase/surge may differ. Cape Lookout C-MAN (CLKN7, since 1984) gives long wind record for fetch-limited wave hindcast. No sound wave gauge.

name: Town of Kitty Hawk
title: Town of Kitty Hawk: SW Kitty Hawk Bay Salt Marsh Wetland Study
setting: Soundside – Kitty Hawk Bay / Albemarle Sound
note: Duck tide gauge (1978–) is ~14 km north on the ocean pier – soundside (Kitty Hawk Bay) levels are wind-driven and not represented. Consider USGS/NCDOT soundside gauges or model output. No river influence.

name: Cape Carteret
title: Cape Carteret: Bogue Sound & Deer Creek Living Shoreline
note: Nearest tide gauges (Beaufort ~36 km; next is Wrightsville, much farther) are far – Bogue Sound water levels are a gap. No USGS gauge on Deer Creek; compound-flood study needs rainfall (NOAA Atlas 14 / gridded) instead of gauged flow.

name: Currituck County
title: Currituck County: Bells Island Road Shoreline Protection
note: Largest gap: Currituck Sound is microtidal/wind-driven; Duck gauge ~32 km away on ocean side. No wave or level sensor in the sound in this inventory. Wind from DUKN7 is usable.

name: Town of Swansboro
title: Town of Swansboro: Hawkins Creek Watershed GSI Retrofits
setting: Estuary – White Oak River / Hawkins Creek
note: Tide gauges ≥41 km away – water level is a gap. New River near Gum Branch (~41 km) is a different basin; Hawkins Creek is ungauged. Expect reliance on ADCIRC/model and rainfall data.

name: Town of Washington Park
title: Town of Washington Park: Riverside Drive & W. Isabella Ave GSI
note: Strong riverine data: Pamlico River at Washington (02084472) ~3 km; Tar at Greenville upstream. USGS 02084472 also records stage – serves as the de-facto water-level gauge. No NOAA tide gauge within ~95 km.

name: Town of Windsor
title: Town of Windsor: Hoggard Mill Water Storage / Flood Attenuation
note: Cashie River is ungauged in this inventory; nearest USGS is Roanoke at Jamesville (~20 km, different river). Coastal water-level/wave data largely irrelevant here – need a Cashie gauge or rainfall-runoff modelling.

name: Town of Duck
title: Town of Duck: NC 12 Soundside Living Shoreline & Sills
note: Best-covered site overall: Duck 8651370 (1978–) ~2 km, FRF buoys 44056/44100 and Nags Head 44086 offshore, DUKN7 met. Caveat: project is soundside, so ocean-side waves/levels are boundary data only.

name: Town of Aurora
title: Town of Aurora: Bailey Creek Tributary Improvements
note: Pamlico at Washington ~36 km upstream; no gauge on Bailey Creek. No NOAA tide gauge nearby – surge propagation up Pamlico must come from models (ADCIRC) or USGS stage records.
